close_reason: domain changes handlers now delegate to handle_changes
description: Every */changes handler (handle_chat_changes, handle_message_changes, handle_space_changes, handle_ban_changes, handle_mailbox_changes, handle_thread_changes, handle_identity_changes, handle_submission_changes, handle_email_changes) contains an identical 15-line block: extract sinceState, extract maxChanges, call get_changes, build the JSON response. The generic handle_changes in jmap-server/src/handlers.rs already implements this correctly. The domain-specific handlers reimplement it either because they add updatedProperties:null (mail handlers) or because they were written before the generic existed. The non-generic handlers should either delegate to handle_changes or extract the common parsing into a shared helper. This is an iterator/collection issue because each handler re-maps result.created/updated/destroyed with .iter().map(|id| id.as_ref()).collect::<Vec<_>>().
title: Repetitive max_changes/sinceState parsing duplicated across every changes handler
